The bridge admits a simultaneous Fourier expansion with common Exp(1) weights; uniform bounded coefficient sizes, exact covariance and Lyapunov yield Gaussian finite-dimensional limits. Centered-exponential fourth moment bounds provide process tightness. The empirical-process KMT sup-norm error and a uniform O(delta) bound on Brownian integrated square increments make the normalization error o_P(1) under delta sqrt(N)/log N -> infinity. The extracted standard-library checker reproduced 770 finite identities and comparisons. Independence among different scales is not falsely assumed.
